README
======

Cell counts are sourced from Florida's Fish and Wildlife Research Institute (FWRI) [[https://myfwc.com/]], HABscope [[https://habscope.gcoos.org/]], Pinellas County Florida [[https://www.pinellascounty.org/environmental/red-tide.htm]], and Sanibel-Captiva Conservation Foundation (SCCF) [[https://www.sccf.org/]]

Forecasted wind speed and direction is sourced from the NOAA Meteorological Development Laboratory (MDL) National Digital Forecast Database (NDFD).

Presence of Karenia Brevis in ocean water with on-shore winds creates the conditions for respiratory
irritation on the beach. This model uses the beach shoreline angle, reported cell count and forecasted
wind speed and direction to predict irritation levels at the location. Possible respiratory forecasts
include 'Very low', 'Low', 'Moderate', and 'High.'

The model is hosted and run at National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Ocean Service (NOS) National Centers for Coastal Ocean Service (NCCOS) every 3 hours.
